region: P1 weather preview: one Open-Meteo centre per 0.5 degree cell on the world fire grid. Longitude runs from -180 to 180 and latitude from -90 to 90 (259200 centres). The P1 command is a dry run, 2001-01-01 through 2025-12-31, and does not call Open-Meteo. --step selects a coarser grid. --fetch would call Open-Meteo and is outside the P1 run.
